FLUIDS / PHOSPHATE

Phosphate

Live KPhos preparation with its potassium contribution shown explicitly.

Use a compatible calcium-free carrier. Do not mix phosphate with LRS or calcium-containing solutions. Dose bands match the workbook and the cited VetEmCrit author guidance. Choose a dose using the patient’s current phosphorus and clinical context. Sources.
